categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies the REST interface handler in src/rest.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents unauthenticated REST queries from spamming debug.log with false-alarm corruption errors. Commit e8af2c7488 notes that queries to `/rest/spenttxouts` for blocks without undo data invoke `ReadBlockUndo()`, producing an alarming `'OpenUndoFile failed for FlatFilePos(nFile=-1, nPos=0)'` error log even though a 404 status is the expected response.
